coverage_notes.identity_and_versions: Seed metadata is checked against requested identifiers and normalized titles, arXiv version suffixes are collapsed, and 10.48550/arXiv aliases map to arXiv keys. Seeds carrying both a publication DOI and an arXiv ID still require manual version reconciliation before a snowballing wave can be called complete.
coverage_notes.interpretation: Index absence is not evidence of nonexistence; citation graphs complement, but do not replace, database queries, full-text screening, artifact inspection, and expert review.
coverage_notes.opencitations: The unified OpenCitations Index v1 API is queried. An authorization token is read from OPENCITATIONS_ACCESS_TOKEN when present but is never persisted. Citation/reference counts are fetched and must match returned relation rows before pagination is treated as complete.
coverage_notes.publication_cutoff: Raw payloads are never discarded. Normalized works and edges carry included, excluded-after-cutoff, or unknown-date status. Every 2026 seed has an exact eligible-version date, while citing works with insufficient dates remain explicit coverage limits.
coverage_notes.semantic_scholar: The Academic Graph API is a mutable provider snapshot. An API key is read from SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY when present but is never persisted. Relation pagination is followed until the provider omits next, an error occurs, or the recorded local ceiling is hit.
